feedback_and_control_causality: Build a six-revolute-joint serial robotic arm with finite link inertia and closed-loop joint actuation.

The arm must solve the Cartesian positioning problem for a desired wrist-centre location and regulate all six joints while carrying a payload, respecting finite actuator torque limits, and recovering from a temporary external joint-load disturbance.
The unscaled actuator torque limits for joints 1--6 are [80,70,60,22,18,14] N*m.
